components_strategy.navigation: Sticky top nav for mobile. Background #FFE600. Logo text in dark. Search bar integrated. Consider bottom navigation bar for mobile app feel.
components_strategy.property_card: Mobile-first width. Image top (aspect ratio 4:3), price large bold (e.g., U$S 150.000), title, location small. Minimal border radius.
components_strategy.wizard_publish: Multi-step form. Prominent step indicator. Full-width 'Continuar' primary button at bottom.
components_strategy.biometric_validation: Simulated camera view overlay. Clear instructions 'Subí tu selfie', 'Foto del frente del DNI', 'Foto del dorso'. Green checkmark on success (#00A650).
components_strategy.calendar_booking: Clean horizontal scroll for dates or standard date picker. Distinct time slot pill buttons.
components_strategy.escrow_checkout: MercadoPago style checkout summary card. Total amount, simulated retention info text. Full-width 'Pagar y Reservar' blue button.
components_strategy.notary_selection: List of notary offices (Escribanías) with rating/distance. 'Seleccionar' inline button.
components_strategy.icons: lucide-react for all icons (Home, Calendar, Camera, MapPin, CheckCircle, Search, User, ChevronRight).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Manrope for headings and Work Sans for body text. Install these via Google Fonts in index.html or import in CSS.
Design mobile-first. Make it feel like a mobile web app (MercadoLibre style). Use full-width buttons and generous padding.
Implement navigation in #FFE600 with dark text/icons. Use #3483FA for primary action buttons.
Build a Multi-step Wizard for publishing properties using Shadcn forms.
For Biometric Validation, create a mock UI resembling a phone camera interface with an overlay framing the face/ID.
Use mock data with values in ARS/USD typical for Argentina (e.g., U$S 120.000, 3 Ambientes, Palermo). Use 'español rioplatense' (e.g., 'Ingresá', 'Subí tu foto').
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
All URLs from 'image_urls' must be used; do not use generic placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
Escrow checkout should simulate a MercadoPago payment modal/screen.
Keep the UI minimalist: ample whitespace, light gray backgrounds #F5F5F5 with stark white #FFFFFF cards.
Avoid unnecessary gradients or decorative elements not aligned with the MercadoPago brand.
